get.description: Returns the space Kibana advanced settings that have been changed from their defaults. Kibana registers this endpoint without public access and does not include it in the upstream Kibana OpenAPI document; requests must send the x-elastic-internal-origin header.

200.description: Indicates a successful call. Returns the user-provided advanced settings for the scope.

settings.description: Advanced settings that differ from the Kibana defaults, keyed by setting name.

userValue.description: The value stored for the setting.

isOverridden.description: True when the setting is overridden in kibana.yml and cannot be changed through the API.

post.description: Updates one or more space Kibana advanced settings. Kibana registers this endpoint without public access and does not include it in the upstream Kibana OpenAPI document; requests must send the x-elastic-internal-origin header.

changes.description: Settings to update, keyed by setting name. A null value resets the setting to its default.

200.description: Indicates a successful call. Returns the user-provided advanced settings for the scope.

settings.description: Advanced settings that differ from the Kibana defaults, keyed by setting name.

userValue.description: The value stored for the setting.

isOverridden.description: True when the setting is overridden in kibana.yml and cannot be changed through the API.
